newsitem.title: UK: Portuguese, Tunisian fuel oil buy tenders this week.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese, Tunisian fuel oil buy tenders this week.

text.p: Portuguese state power company Electridade de Portugal (EdP) will announce on Wednesday the results of a high sulphur fuel oil buy tender, market sources said on Tuesday.
The tender, which is for one cargo of 25,000 tonnes to arrive 6-8 April along with an option for EdP to buy another 25,000 tonnes at a later date, closed on Monday afternoon.
EdP's last tender, for 18-22,000 tonnes of high sulphur fuel, closed on March 16, with delivery by this month's end.
Traders said that Tunisia's state refiner had issued a tender to receive high sulphur fuel oil around April 6 in exchange for a cargo of low sulphur straight-run.
The tender, due to close on Wednesday, was the second such deal this month, with the first straight-run cargo heard to have been bought by a large Italian utility.
